cohort: 100 pregnant women at term in a tertiary care hospital
finding: Oral mifepristone given for preinduction cervical ripening was found to be effective and safe with a reduction in the need for additional prostaglandins and oxytocin and also shorter induction-to-delivery interval with no serious maternal or fetal adverse effects.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was 82% in the mifepristone group and 80% in the expectant management group.
